description: What an esp32bench:// link from the site asks the app to open: esp32bench://project/<id>, optionally with ?board=<board>. Returns the project if it is in the cached library, and the board if that project has a build for it (else null). Nothing is built or flashed; building what a link opened still needs consent like anything else.

url.description: The link, as the desktop environment passed it to the app.
